home.heading: Shopify + Cloudflare scaffold
home.runtimeBody: This app runs in the Cloudflare Workers runtime. Sessions live in KV, app state lives in D1 via Drizzle, and both are real bindings in local dev as well as production.
home.installMissing: No install row in D1 yet — it is written when OAuth completes.

feedback.heading: We're new, and we're listening
feedback.body: This app is just getting started, and we ship fast based on what merchants tell us. Something missing, something broken, or an idea that would make your day easier? Send it our way.
feedback.action: Share feedback or request a feature

dashboard.heading: Home
dashboard.intro: Here is what is happening across your store today.
dashboard.channelsEmptyBody: Sales by channel appear here once your store has orders.

setupGuide.heading: Finish setting up your store
setupGuide.body: Complete these steps to start selling with confidence.

steps.connectBody: Link your sales channels and preferences.
steps.connectAlt: Person preparing a store setup checklist
steps.catalogBody: Build a catalog shoppers will love.
steps.analyticsBody: See which channels are driving growth.

errors.missingShop: Please enter your shop domain to log in
errors.invalidShop: Please enter a valid shop domain to log in

billing.heading: Billing

current.trial: Your free trial ends {{date}}. After that, you'll be charged {{price}}.
current.cancelsOn: Your subscription ends on {{date}}. You keep access until then.
current.cancelsAtPeriodEnd: Your subscription is set to end. You keep access until the end of the current billing period.
current.frozen: Your payments are on hold, so this plan isn't active. Update your billing details in Shopify to restore it.
current.pending: This plan is waiting for your approval in Shopify. Nothing changes until you approve it.
current.cancelled: This subscription was cancelled. Choose a plan to subscribe again.
current.inactive: This store has no active subscription. Choose a plan to subscribe.

plans.heading: Plans
plans.body: Choose or change your plan any time.

billing.managedNote: Plans are managed by Shopify. Use the button above to view available plans, upgrade, or change your subscription.
billing.managedNoteNoLink: Plans are managed by Shopify, so changes to your plan are made outside this app.

processing.heading: Updating your plan
processing.body: Checking the latest details from Shopify. This usually takes only a moment.
processing.failedHeading: We could not update your plan
processing.failedBody: Try again to check the latest details from Shopify.
processing.toastDone: Your plan is up to date
processing.toastFailed: We could not update your plan

billing.loadFailedBody: Reload the page to try again. If this keeps happening, contact support.
billing.planLinkUnavailable: The plan link is unavailable right now. Reload the page to try again.

support.heading: Support

empty.heading: No tickets yet
empty.body: Use New ticket to report a problem or ask a question. We will reply here.

form.heading: What can we help with?
form.category: What kind of issue is this?
form.subject: Subject
form.bodyHelp: What you expected, what happened instead, and where. A screenshot or recording helps most.
form.emailHelp: We reply here as well as in the app. Clear it to only be notified in the app.
form.ccHelp: They get every reply, and can reply themselves. Up to {{max}}.
form.attachmentLimits: Up to {{max}} files. Images up to {{image}}, video up to {{video}}, other files up to {{file}}.
form.attachmentsSkipped: Only {{max}} files fit in one message. The extra files were not added.
form.replyExpectation: We reply by email and in this thread.

thread.replyPlaceholder: Add anything else that might help
thread.closedNotice: This ticket is closed. Replying will reopen it.
thread.reviewPrompt: We value your feedback. Let us know how we're doing.
thread.notFoundBody: It may have been removed. Go back to your tickets to find it.

errors.rate_limited: You have sent a lot of messages just now. Try again in a minute.
errors.empty_reply: Write a message or attach a file.
errors.upload_failed: That file could not be uploaded. Try again.
errors.unsupported_type: That file type is not supported.
errors.invalid_cc: That copy list is not valid. Check each email address.
errors.invalid_upload: An attachment is no longer available, so nothing was sent. Add your files again.
errors.invalid_cc_email: That does not look like an email address.
errors.duplicate_cc_email: That address is already on the list.
errors.too_many_cc_emails: The list is full. Remove someone to add another.

success.created: Ticket sent. We will reply here.

fieldErrors.invalid_cc_email: One of the copied addresses is not a valid email address.
fieldErrors.too_many_cc_emails: You can copy up to {{max}} people.
fieldErrors.invalid: Check this field and try again.

support.loadFailedBody: Reload the page to try again. If this keeps happening, contact support.

pending.heading: Waiting for approval
pending.body: Your request to use {{appName}} has been sent. When an owner of this store lets you in, reload this page.

removed.heading: You no longer have access
removed.body: An owner of this store removed you from {{appName}}. Ask them to restore your access.

not_invited.heading: You need an invitation
not_invited.body: {{appName}} is open to people an owner of this store has invited. Ask an owner to invite your email address.

forbidden.heading: You do not have permission for this
forbidden.body: Your role does not include this page. Ask an owner of this store to change your role.

seat_limit.heading: Your plan has no free seat for you
seat_limit.body: This store's {{appName}} plan has a limited number of seats, and yours was given up when the team went over it. When a seat is free, an owner or admin of this store can let you back in.

owner.label: Owner
owner.description: Everything, including the plan. The only role that can make, change or remove an owner.

admin.label: Admin
admin.description: Everything an owner can do, including the plan and the team, except make, change or remove an owner.

member.label: Member
member.description: Uses the app and changes its settings and data.

viewer.label: Viewer
viewer.description: Can look but not change anything.

invite.heading: Add a member
invite.emailHint: They join the first time they open {{appName}} with this address verified in Shopify.
invite.seatsFull: Every seat is in use. You can save this person now, but they wait to be let in until a seat is free.
invite.seatsUnreadable: We cannot read your plan's seat limit right now. You can save this person, but they wait to be let in until it can be read.

seats.heading: Seats
seats.full: Every seat is in use. Remove someone or change your plan to let more people in.
seats.over: Your plan's seat limit is {{max}} and {{used}} are in use. Nobody is removed, but nobody new can join until you are within the limit.
seats.overTrim: Your plan's seat limit is {{max}} and {{used}} are in use. Nobody new can join. If the team is still over the limit when the notice period ends, the people with the fewest privileges lose their seat. Owners never do.
seats.unreadable: We cannot read your plan's seat limit right now, so nobody new can be let in. Try again in a moment.

waiting.heading: People are waiting to be let in: {{count}}
waiting.body: They opened {{appName}} and cannot use it yet. Open a person below to let them in, or remove them.

table.label: Team
table.truncated: Showing the first {{shown}} people. {{hidden}} more are not shown.

confirmRemove.heading: Remove {{name}}?
confirmRemove.body: They lose access to {{appName}} straight away. You can restore them later.

success.invited: Invitation saved. Ask them to open {{appName}} from their Shopify admin.
success.approved: They can use the app now.

errors.forbidden: You cannot do that. Only an owner or admin can manage the team, and only an owner can make, change or remove an owner.
errors.notFound: That person is no longer on the team.
errors.notYourself: You cannot change or remove your own membership here. Ask another owner.
errors.lastOwner: This is the store's only owner. Make someone else an owner first.
errors.lastManager: Someone who can manage the team has to stay. Make someone else an owner or admin first.
errors.noSeat: Your plan has no free seat for another person. Remove someone or change your plan.
errors.invalidState: That person changed in the meantime. Reload the page and try again.
errors.alreadyMember: That address is already on the team or has an open invitation.
errors.roleInvalid: Choose one of the listed roles.
errors.customUnavailable: This app does not let you choose permissions one by one. Pick a role instead.
errors.ownerFixed: An owner always has every permission.
errors.permissionInvalid: Choose permissions from the list, and keep the one that lets someone open the app.
errors.cannotGrant: You can only give permissions you have yourself. Managing the team comes with the Owner or Admin role.

detail.notChangeable: You cannot change this person's access.
detail.isYou: This is you. Ask another owner or admin to change your access.
detail.basedOn: Started from {{role}}. Choosing a role replaces their permissions.
detail.permissionsEditable: Choose what {{name}} can do. Everyone can open the app.
detail.roleOnlyHint: Only comes with the Owner or Admin role.
detail.notYoursHint: You do not have this permission yourself.
detail.customHint: Saving gives them permissions of their own. Choosing a role later replaces them.

state.invited: Nobody has opened {{appName}} with this address yet. When they do, they join with the role below.
state.waiting: {{name}} opened {{appName}} and is waiting to be let in. Choose a role to let them in, or remove them.
state.noSeat: {{name}} lost their seat when the plan's seat limit was lowered, so they cannot use {{appName}}. Choose a role to give them a seat again once one is free.
state.removed: {{name}} was removed and cannot use {{appName}}. Choose a role to bring them back.

detail.seatFull: Every seat is in use, so nobody can be let in right now. Free a seat or change your plan.
detail.seatUnreadable: We cannot read your plan's seat limit right now, so nobody can be let in. Try again in a moment.

appManage.label: Change settings and data
appManage.description: Create and edit what the app holds.

billingManage.label: Manage the plan
billingManage.description: See and change the plan and billing.

membersManage.label: Manage the team
membersManage.description: Invite people, change roles and permissions, and remove people.

noSeat.heading: People without a seat: {{count}}
noSeat.body: Your plan's seat limit is lower than the team, so they lost their seat and cannot use {{appName}}. Open a person below to give them a seat again once one is free.

confirmCancel.heading: Cancel the invitation for {{name}}?
confirmCancel.body: Nobody has opened {{appName}} with this address yet. The invitation is deleted and cannot be used to join.
